rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are companion communications issued alongside an Executive order administering the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act; both then explain agency relationships, justify centralized coordination of dispersed agricultural programs, call for bringing those activities into harmonious alignment with foreign policy, and identify an official expected to advise or lead coordination. C16 and C07 contain related companion-memorandum machinery, but their verbal and subject-matter correspondence is less concentrated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have today issued an Executive Order relating to the duties of the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program. ... The purpose of this memorandum is to describe further the role of the Director
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have today issued an Executive order providing for the administration of the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954. It is the purpose of this letter to further define relationships among the several agencies
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared opening and companion-document structure: announcement of a newly issued Executive order followed by a further explanation of administrative roles.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Many Government functions and activities relate to the overseas movement of agricultural commodities ... It is important that responsibility for coordination of all these efforts be centralized
shared_material.parent_excerpt: These programs are currently carried on by many agencies of the Government. ... The very fact that a number of agencies have a responsibility in one or another aspect of surplus disposition makes effective coordination absolutely essential.
shared_material.explanation: Both identify dispersed governmental responsibility for overseas agricultural programs as the reason for creating centralized coordination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to exercise affirmative leadership and continuous supervision over the various activities in this field, so that they may be brought into harmonious relationship
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to assist the agencies concerned in bringing into harmonious action ... the various agricultural surplus disposal activities
shared_material.explanation: The uncommon 'bringing into harmonious' formulation and the same coordination function strongly indicate reusable language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I know that in all of his endeavors the Director will have your full support and cooperation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: mobilizing the total resources of Government ... With effective administration ... we should make substantial strides
shared_material.explanation: Both close by soliciting government-wide cooperation to make the coordinated program effective, reinforcing the shared administrative design.
